description: This file defines the ViewHandler interface for the Apache OFBiz framework, specifying methods for initializing, rendering views, and preparing view contexts.

classes.name: ViewHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling views, including initialization, rendering, and context preparation.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the view handler as declared in the controller configuration file.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the view handler as declared in the controller configuration file.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the handler; used once when the singleton is created, leveraging servlet context.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the specified view to the response, using request, response, and context data.

methods.name: prepareViewContext
methods.description: Prepares, secures, and analyzes the request, response, and view configuration to produce a context map for rendering.
